newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank sets rates for three, six-month rrps.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank sets rates for three, six-month rrps.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it had set its rate for the three and six-month reverse repos at 13.25 percent and 14 percent.
These were previously at 12.625 percent each.
Central bank governor Gabriel Singson had said late on Wednesday the three and six months would carry a rate of 13 percent effective Thursday.
He said the upward adjustment in rates were meant to align them with the current T-bill rates.
